'''Hercie Beta''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] enemy of the [[Eternal Empire]] of [[Zakuul]]. In [[3630 BBY]] she and her partner [[Frederci Beta]] were captured and imprisoned in the [[Overwatch]]. However, during their interrogation, [[Kaliyo Djannis]] and [[Alliance Commander|The Commander]] [[Raid on the Overwatch|assaulted]] the Overwatch, enabling them to escape.<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Hercie Beta appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]'' '''Chapter 10: Anarchy in Paradise'''.
